sources.citation: Motingea Mangulu, André. 1990. La langue des Zámba [Sous-groupe Zamba: Esquisse du parler des Zamba]. In Parlers riverains de l'entre Ubangi-Zaïre: éléments de structure grammaticale (Études Aequatoria 8), 107-123. Bamanya: Centre Aequatoria.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Silent on stress/accent. p. 108 'I. Phonologie' (7 oral vowels, consonants, /kp gb/, syllabic nasal, devocalisation, vowel harmony, coalescence); p. 109 'La tonologie': tone language with a mid tone, floating/'displaced' tonology, tone not fixed on a given morpheme. No word 'accent' in the sketch except the adverb of intensity on p. 122.
